# December 2025

## 2025-12-03 — Winter battery swap round, western stations

Swapped batteries at AWS-01, AWS-02, and AWS-04 ahead of the shortest days
of the year, since these three sit in the most shaded ground on the
network and voltage there drops fastest once the sun angle gets low.
AWS-02's old battery came out reading noticeably weaker than the other two,
and was retired rather than kept as a spare, on the view that a battery
already struggling in early December wasn't going to make it through
January.

## 2025-12-11 — Storm damage, eastern ridge

An overnight storm on the 10th brought down a section of fence near AWS-08
and knocked the AWS-08 antenna mount out of true, though the mast itself
stayed upright. Frame loss on that hop was heavy for about two days
afterwards until the mount was straightened on a visit on the 12th; no
permanent damage found once it was back in alignment. The fence was left
for the landowner to deal with rather than repaired, since it isn't network
property, but the break was reported so livestock didn't wander through it
in the meantime.

## 2025-12-18 — Firmware 1.5.2 held back

Firmware 1.5.2 was staged for the network but held back after the early
test batch on two stations showed an intermittent reboot under cold
conditions that hadn't shown up in warmer testing earlier in the year. Kept
on 1.5.1 across the whole network for the rest of the month rather than
risk a mid-winter rollout of something that reboots unpredictably in the
cold; the cold-reboot issue was logged for the firmware work to pick up
before trying again in the new year.

## 2025-12-27 — Battery swap round, eastern stations

Second and final battery round of the year, covering AWS-06 through AWS-09
in one long day between Christmas and New Year while the roads were
unusually quiet. All four came out reading close to expected for the time
of year, no early retirements this time. AWS-09 was the lowest of the four
but still comfortably inside range, flagged only as one to watch on the
first round of the new year rather than acted on now.
